description: Archived pretraining/CETVEL results audited against UHeM on 2026-11-09. Original eleven-model CETVEL values use a legacy evaluator with known deviations; later corrected results are separate.

metric_definitions.validation_bpb: Sum of non-special target-token negative log probabilities in nats / (ln(2) * represented UTF-8 bytes); lower is better.
metric_definitions.final_train_loss: Last printed token-level training loss at step 17099/17100; vocabulary-dependent, not directly comparable across tokenizers.
metric_definitions.macro_core11: Unweighted mean of 11 selected classification/log-likelihood task scores, with acc_norm preferred except XCOPA acc; scale 0-1, higher is better.
metric_definitions.xquad_tr_f1: XQuAD token-overlap F1 on 0-100 scale; separate from the core-11 mean.
metric_definitions.core12_examples_per_second: 39441 expanded effective examples divided by logged end-to-end core-12 elapsed seconds; hardware/harness throughput proxy, not isolated tokenization speed.

controls.hardware_recipe: 4 x A100, launcher profile; per-run full hardware logs remain on UHeM
controls.context_recipe: 2048 token positions, launcher/default recipe; not equal characters of context
controls.seed_evidence: Source initialization uses torch seed 42; individual archived run summaries do not contain a complete seed/config manifest.
controls.audit_scope: Ten original effective model/user configurations and training reports were recovered. The original raw-BPE32k metadata is absent, but its training log survives. No complete per-run training Git/environment fingerprint is established.

limitations: June CETVEL ignored generation stop/max-length kwargs and did not validate exact context/continuation token boundaries. Original XQuAD claims are superseded by the correction audit; complete corrected tokenizer-ablation evaluation remains missing.
Cross-vocabulary comparisons change depth and approximate parameter count; tokenizer effects should be compared within a tier.
Fixed token positions do not fix raw bytes/documents consumed. Per-run raw exposure accounting is absent from the compact summaries.
Validation uses a fixed token-position budget; byte normalization does not prove identical raw-text evaluation spans across tokenizers.
Per-token training loss is vocabulary-dependent; use BPB as the loss comparison, subject to evaluation-span caveats.
Single runs without seed replications or paired significance tests; task standard errors in recovered raw files are not confidence intervals for tokenizer differences.
Base-model CETVEL results do not establish instruction-following or post-SFT assistant quality.
Archived BPB, macro and task cells are rounded to four decimals; recomputing a macro from rounded task cells may differ in the last digit.
The 128k TurkishDelight result was complete while Slurm was finishing uploads at import time; current scheduler state was not reverified.

d32_launch.scope: coverage-oriented approximately one-pass raw-BPE budget over all 30 FineWeb-2 Turkish source shards

dataset.cached_manifest_provenance: legacy filename inventory whose revision field is main; cached names and sizes match the resolved Hub revision

split_policy.note: All 30 unique source shards are optimization-eligible. Because no independent validation corpus was requested, the last source shard is also exposed under its original name as a train-overlap diagnostic validation set; its validation BPB is not a held-out generalization estimate.

horizon.derivation: payload tokens plus one document BOS position; preserving cropped tails prevents intentional payload-tail loss

rank_balance_estimate.method: exact epoch-one row-group assignment with parquet metadata byte counts used as a token-volume proxy

horizon.semantics: 28,000 updates schedule 58,720,256,000 model positions, 0.550% above measured corpus payload tokens plus one BOS per document. Under the seed-42 ws8 row-group assignment this leaves 120 updates beyond the 0.118% max-rank uncompressed-byte proxy. This is a coverage-oriented heuristic intended to make an uninterrupted run likely to consume every source payload token at least once; the online infinite best-fit loader may interleave epoch-two documents before all epoch-one buffered tails are consumed, and legacy checkpoint resume is not exact, so neither unique-token completeness nor exact-once exposure is guaranteed.

launch.gpu_binding: allocation-level gpu:a100:4 per node; srun --gres=none plus manual CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=SLURM_LOCALID because Altay Slurm 20.11 uses select/linear and task/none

completed_preflight.four_a100_localid_nccl_result: four ranks each saw one A100 and all-reduce sum 6.0

launch.automatic_resume: latest checkpoint containing model, metadata, and all eight optimizer shards
launch.known_live_scheduler_constraint: At audit time only one a100x4q node was idle; a two-node allocation remains pending until another node is healthy.

auxiliary.warning: Diagnostic only. The paper does not define its prose macro-F1; published Tables 4/5 are reproduced by exact match.

qa.normalizer: lowercase + ASCII punctuation/articles removal + whitespace collapse

eacl_table_compatible_receipt.overall_aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean of the seven category scores

warnings: GECTurk uses stripped exact match for Table 4 compatibility. Section 4.2 says macro-F1, but the released task and published Kanarya value prove the table uses exact match.
The MCQA aggregate includes check_worthiness and relevance_judgment although Table 6 does not display those columns.
The paper identifies TabiBERT BERTScore but does not publish all BERTScore settings. This implementation pins F1, final layer 22, and rescale_with_baseline=false in the metric receipt.
